description: Filter images by observation unit, observation, study, descriptive ontology term, file name, or MIME type. Returns metadata only — use brapi_get_image to fetch bytes inline. When the upstream total exceeds loadLimit, the full result set is materialized as a dataframe — query it with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

alias.description: Connection alias registered via brapi_connect. Omit to read the connection registered under alias `default` — i.e. a prior brapi_connect call that did not specify an alias. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

extraFilters.description: Extra BrAPI filters forwarded verbatim. Valid keys vary by endpoint; brapi_describe_filters enumerates them. Named params on this tool take precedence on conflict.

loadLimit.description: Cap on rows returned inline. Omit for the deployment default. Rows beyond the cap land in a dataframe; query with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL) instead of paging row-by-row.

name: brapi_find_images

alias.description: Alias of the registered BrAPI connection the call used.

appliedFilters.description: The final filter map sent to the server (named + extraFilters).

dataframe.description: Dataframe handle when the full result set was materialized as a dataframe. Query it with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

columnLegend.description: Maps a sanitized column name back to its original upstream key, for columns renamed to clear the SQL-safe-identifier gate (e.g. `end` → `end_`). Present only when a column was renamed — write SQL against the sanitized (left-hand) names.

columns.description: Full column list of the dataframe.

items.description: Column name from the materialized rows.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the dataframe was created.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the dataframe metadata will be purged. Re-run the find_* tool to refresh, or copy results out before expiry.

maxRows.description: Cap that was applied at create time, when truncation occurred.

rowCount.description: Number of rows materialized in the dataframe.

tableName.description: Dataframe name. Use with brapi_dataframe_describe (schema + provenance) and brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

totalCount.description: Total rows reported by the upstream server (may exceed rowCount when truncated).

truncated.description: True when the dataframe hit a row cap before exhausting upstream.

distributions.description: Value frequency per field across the full result set.

descriptiveOntologyTerms.description: Ontology term → count of images tagged with that term.

mimeType.description: MIME type → count of images with that type.

observationUnitName.description: Observation unit name → count of images tied to that unit.

studyName.description: Study name → count of images in that study.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection has been registered under the requested alias. `all_filters_dropped`: The active dialect dropped every filter the agent supplied — the upstream server does not honor any of the requested scope filters on this endpoint, so the call would silently widen to the unfiltered baseline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when more rows exist beyond the returned set.

notice.description: Guidance when no rows were returned — how to broaden filters or retry.

refinementHint.description: Suggested next-step query refinement when the result set is large.

results.description: Image metadata rows returned in-context (up to loadLimit).

imageFileSize.description: File size in bytes. Coerced from string when the upstream emits a numeric string.

imageHeight.description: Pixel height. Coerced from string when the upstream emits a numeric string.

imageURL.description: URL where the bytes live (may be relative to baseUrl or absolute).

imageWidth.description: Pixel width. Coerced from string when the upstream emits a numeric string.

observationDbIds.description: FKs to observations this image is evidence for.

observationUnitDbId.description: FK to the observation unit this image depicts.

observationUnitName.description: Display name of the observation unit.

studyDbId.description: FK to the study the image belongs to.

totalCount.description: Total rows reported by the server.

warnings.description: Advisory messages (filter overrides, partial data, capability gaps).
